message: 欲しい

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, today ain't a bargain day, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't come here to shop. I thought it might give me some ideas for the Holy Night Festival.」
Time sure flies--it's already late November. It's around the time when Shiokumi Shopping District starts putting up its Christmas decorations.
Because they value the aesthetic harmony of the streetscape, they don't put flashy illuminations out on the roads, but in exchange, the interior displays of the shops are elaborate.

name: Ria
message: 「How about this shop over here?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「They've decorated it quite tastefully. Still, it doesn't quite strike a chord with me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, Akane-chan, your standards are way too strict!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「This is going to be our final Holy Night Festival, after all. I don't want to make any compromises.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」
Ria-senpai and Misasagi-senpai appeared from around the street corner.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello. Are the two of you out shopping?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yahoo! Running into Ria-chan by coincidence like this--does that mean the two of us are tied together by the red string of fate?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Black Tights, let's class things up with a double date!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That sounds lovely. Then it'll be Rii-a and me, paired with Kaichou-han and Paqy-san, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Was that how it was?! Paqy, you felt that way about me...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama ain't half bad either, but spare me that deadpan idiocy.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe, it's not a coincidence, so the date will have to wait!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then you two are also--」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep! We're taking a stroll through the shopping district to look for hints for the Holy Night Festival. Hmph-hmph!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We came here because we were meant to come. And we met because we were meant to meet, didn't we?」

name: Ria
message: 「What's the matter, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「I really still can't hold a candle to you, Senpai. I should have brought my classmates along too, not just Paqy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Otherwise, no matter how much we use the shopping district for reference, our perspective will end up skewed.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Whether you've caught up to Rii-a and surpassed her is something to think about next year, Kaichou-han.」

name: Ria
message: 「True, a one-year gap isn't easy to close, you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, you figured that out on your own, Synn-kun. I'm sure you'll become a wonderful Student Council President, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, shall we see what kind of magic you'll work for this year's Holy Night Festival?」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, Akane-chan, you're putting pressure on him on purpose, aren't you?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ohohoho, forgive me. When a child is that cute, I just can't help teasing him.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm... Misasagi-senpai, please tell me. What is the thing you want most right here, right now?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That was decided ages ago.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's this.」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan?」
Misasagi-senpai grabs Ria-senpai by the scruff of her collar, as if pinching up a kitten.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I get it, you want my uniform? Heehee, once we graduate, let's trade them with each other as a keepsake!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, just like how soccer players swap jerseys after a match.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「...No, it is not.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Be quiet. Hmph!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Madan!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「K-Kukuku, I might... go down... but Ria-chan won't... fall, ya hear? Thud.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There is still time.」

name: Ria
message: 「...? I don't really get it, but if you get rough with Paa-chan, bad girl!」
For a while after that, I walked around the shopping district with Ria-senpai and the others, carrying an unconscious Paqy.
It's still a bit vague, but I think it gave me a good reference for creating an atmosphere fitting for the Holy Night Festival.
